species.name: Cave Fang
species.description: An ancient relative of Zubat, it hunts in pitch-black caves using ultrasonic cries. Its oversized fangs inject a powerful venom, paralyzing prey before it can escape.

species.name: Abyss Lure
species.description: An ancient relative of Lanturn, it roamed the deepest oceans using its enormous fins. Its golden lure emits an enchanting glow that draws unsuspecting prey straight into its powerful jaws.

species.name: Ancestrash
species.description: An ancient relative of Garbodor, it piles bones and decaying vegetation onto its muddy body. Toxic fumes seep from the rotting mass, turning the ground around it into a deadly bog.

species.name: Burial Gaze
species.description: An ancient relative of Duskull, it wanders forgotten burial grounds with its body covered in grave dust. Those who meet its unblinking gaze are said to hear the voices of spirits buried deep underground.

species.name: Craggy Siphon
species.description: An ancient relative of Octillery, it ruled rocky coastal waters with its immense strength. It strikes foes with stone-hard tentacles and fires powerful jets of water from its muscular siphon.

species.name: Dire Ruff
species.description: An ancient relative of Mightyena, it hunted in ruthless packs across barren plains. Its jagged mane bristles as it kicks up blinding clouds of dust, allowing its pack to ambush unsuspecting prey.

species.name: Dread Crest
species.description: An ancient relative of Noctowl, it ruled the skies above barren canyons. Its enormous crest intimidated rivals, while its powerful wings stirred up blinding dust clouds to conceal its attacks.

species.name: Fetid Gullet
species.description: An ancient relative of Swalot, it swallowed decaying matter from primeval marshes without pause. The foul gases in its cavernous body are said to trap the lingering spirits of anything it consumes.

species.name: Fossil Husk
species.description: An ancient relative of Pineco, it developed a shell of mineralized plates as hard as solid rock. It clung to trees along prehistoric cliffs, dropping onto predators with enough force to shatter stone.

species.name: Fossl Tide
species.description: An ancient relative of Gastrodon, it absorbed iron from the prehistoric seafloor to form a thick metallic shell. Its armored body could withstand crushing ocean currents and attacks from enormous predators.

species.name: Jagged Maw
species.description: An ancient relative of Cloyster, it lurked among submerged cliffs, disguising its jagged shell as stone. When prey approached, its enormous jaws snapped shut with enough force to crush solid rock.

species.name: Miasmic
species.description: An ancient relative of Weezing, it drifted through toxic marshes while spewing a noxious yellow haze. Prey that inhaled its miasma grew weak and disoriented, making them easy targets for its vicious assault.

species.name: Mire crest
species.description: An ancient relative of Skuntank, it flares its towering mane to frighten rivals. It fights with deceptive lunges and crushing claw strikes, refusing to retreat even when outnumbered.

species.name: Phantomire
species.description: An ancient relative of Haunter, it prowled mist-covered marshes long before humans existed. Its spectral hands spread unnatural darkness, trapping unsuspecting prey in terrifying illusions.

species.name: Frost Plume
species.description: An ancient relative of Dewgong, it glided beneath polar ice on featherlike fins. Its icy breath froze seawater into sharp crystals, driving away even the fiercest predators.

species.name: Spined Wyrm
species.description: An ancient relative of Caterpie, it charged larger predators with its dragonlike horns. Its armored segments and sharp spines made it a fearsome forest dweller.

species.name: Tidal Tyrant
species.description: An ancient relative of Drednaw, it stalked prehistoric seas beneath a jagged, armored shell. Its crushing jaws could drag even massive prey into the depths.

species.name: Witchcap Haze
species.description: An ancient relative of Shiinotic, it lures wanderers beneath its glowing cap. The spores it sheds cause vivid hallucinations before slowly numbing the body.

species.name: Burrow Brawler
species.description: An ancient relative of Lopunny, it carved deep burrows with its powerful hind legs. Its devastating kicks could crack the ground beneath charging predators.

species.name: Canopy Titan
species.description: An ancient relative of Tropius, it carried enormous leaflike wings above its back. Its long neck reached fruit growing far beyond the reach of other Pokémon.

species.name: Timber Maul
species.description: An ancient relative of Conkeldurr, it uprooted whole trees to wield as clubs. Its mighty blows left deep fractures across the earth.

species.name: Tempest Talon
species.description: An ancient relative of Pidgeot, it challenged rivals with ferocious aerial dives. Its powerful talons could knock even large Pokémon out of the sky.

species.name: Cinder Coil
species.description: An ancient relative of Centiskorch, it guarded volcanic tunnels with its armored coils. Its glowing plates radiated enough heat to drive away predators.

species.name: Rime Shroud
species.description: An ancient relative of Venomoth, it drifted through frozen forests, scattering icy scales that numbed anything they touched. Its powder lingered in the frigid air for hours.

species.name: Tar Chasm
species.description: An ancient relative of Muk, it lurked in primeval tar pits, its sludge thick with bones and sediment. Prey pulled into its gaping maw rarely escaped.

species.name: Venom Crown
species.description: An ancient relative of Seaking, it spread its venomous fins like a crown to warn predators. A single prick from its spines could paralyze even larger foes.

species.name: Spore Rampart
species.description: An ancient relative of Parasect, it grew jagged, stone-hard fungal plates across its back. It used its massive claws to defend the spore colonies beneath its shell.

species.name: Venom Scythe
species.description: An ancient relative of Seviper, it hunted through primeval jungles using its scythe-shaped tail. Venom seeping from the blade could weaken even towering predators.

species.name: Primatizer
species.description: Its massive, stone-plated claw fires bursts of pressurized water strong enough to shatter coral. It ambushes prey among ancient reefs.

species.name: Scorch Mane
species.description: An ancient relative of Rapidash, it galloped across volcanic plains with a mane crackling with electricity. Its blazing hooves left trails of fire wherever it ran.

species.name: Scoria Shell
species.description: An ancient relative of Magcargo, it crawled through volcanic craters with a shell of hardened scoria. Molten rock constantly seeped from the cracks in its body, scorching everything in its path.

species.name: Titan Baleen
species.description: An ancient relative of Wailord, it crossed prehistoric seas in metallic armor. Its tough baleen strained whole shoals of fish, while its dorsal spines repelled predators.

species.name: Wooly sting
species.description: An ancient relative of Gliscor, it glided between icy cliffs with thick fur shielding it from the cold. It used its powerful pincers and hooked tail to repel rivals.

species.name: iron crawler
species.description: A futuristic relative of Wimpod, it scuttles across polluted shores. Its glowing sensors detect toxins, which it absorbs and releases as a defensive mist.

species.name: Iron Crusher
species.description: A futuristic relative of Kingler, it patrols the seafloor with hydraulic claws. Its oversized pincer can crush the metal hulls of sunken vessels.

species.name: iron feaster
species.description: A futuristic relative of Snorlax, it devours scrap metal to charge the reactor in its belly. Once fully powered, it enters a deep, motionless sleep.

species.name: iron invernose
species.description: A futuristic relative of Centiskorch, it slithers through industrial tunnels with a body heated like a furnace. The vents along its armor release bursts of flame to melt obstacles in its path.

species.name: iron leporis
species.description: A futuristic relative of Lopunny, it stores electricity in its powerful limbs to unleash explosive jumps. Its blade-like ears and charged kicks can disable foes in an instant.

species.name: Iron maeltrom
species.description: A futuristic relative of Gyarados, it uses turbines along its armored body to fly over raging seas. The violent air currents it creates can capsize ships.

species.name: Archgutor
species.description: After decades on tropical beaches, this evolution of Exeggutor stores solar energy in its coconuts. It uses sun-powered moves even beneath storm clouds.

species.name: Dynamotrode
species.description: An evolution of Electrode resembling a Fast Ball, it propels itself with electromagnetic bursts. It rolls so quickly that sparks trail behind it.

species.name: Magnetrix
species.description: An alternate evolution of Magneton, it spins four powerful magnets around its core to build immense electrical pressure. It can electrify the ground or propel itself through the air at incredible speed.

species.name: Magiscale
species.description: An alternate evolution of Magikarp, it reads ocean currents through its golden whiskers. With a pulse of its mind, it blankets the battlefield in psychic energy.

species.name: Ammnoid
species.description: After exposure to a Dusk Stone, Omanyte evolves into Ammnoid. Its gold-banded shell amplifies psychic pulses that reveal movement across the dark seafloor.

species.name: Cephalonid
species.description: Its horned shell stores immense psychic energy. When the blue gem on its crown flashes, Cephalonid can bend deep-sea currents and repel predators without touching them.

species.name: Stundrift
species.description: Buried deep beneath the seabed, it absorbs energy from rushing water and shifting earth. Its golden markings glow before it releases a powerful electric shock.

species.name: Swadloadne
species.description: After evolving with a Leaf Stone, it guards its forest beneath overlapping leaf shields. Thick inner padding protects it from heat and cold, while its armor covers vulnerable spots.

basis: Dados atuais do projeto, com referências da geração 9
